name: Frond
author: Erin Carter
description: A leaf skeleton lies diagonally across the frame and burns from its margin inward: a glowing incandescent rim traces an ever-shrinking copy of the leaf's outline, graded warm-to-cool across its width, while the veins it crosses keep a dim cooling glow behind it. When one leaf is consumed a second on the opposite diagonal ignites at its own margin, crossfaded so the burn never restarts.

params.label: Burn rate
params.effect: How fast the margin contracts toward the midrib.

params.label: Rim width
params.effect: Width in CSS px of the glowing margin rim.

params.label: Vein afterglow
params.effect: How long crossed veins keep their cooling glow; 0 snuffs them the moment the front passes.

params.label: Margin raggedness
params.effect: FBM roughness of the burning margin; 0 keeps it a clean offset of the leaf edge.
